reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Supreme court authority to answer certified questions of Missouri law
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri supreme court to answer questions of Missouri law certified by federal courts absent controlling precedent.

headings.title: Invocation of certification order on court motion or party motion
headings.reviewNote: Permits certification order upon federal court's own motion or motion of any party to the pending proceeding.

headings.title: Preparation, contents, and transmission of federal certification orders
headings.reviewNote: Specifies certification order contents, relevant facts, judicial signature, transmission under seal, and supreme court authority to request certifying court records.

headings.title: Discretionary acceptance of certified questions by Missouri supreme court
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that Missouri supreme court is not required to accept or answer any certified case.

headings.title: Fees, costs, and equal division between parties
headings.reviewNote: Provides that fees and costs match civil appeals docketed in supreme court and are equally divided between parties unless certifying court orders otherwise.

headings.title: Transmission of written supreme court opinion to federal court and parties
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerk to transmit written supreme court opinion under seal to certifying court and parties.

headings.title: Severability of certification of law provisions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes severability of section provisions and applications if any portion is held invalid.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 7 subsections governing federal certified questions of Missouri law; tightened subsection 5 title to match "fees and costs".

headings.title: Written appellate opinions and non-unanimous judicial votes
headings.reviewNote: Requires written opinions filed in appellate cases or final motion dispositions, showing authoring, concurring, and dissenting judges when not unanimous.

headings.title: Clerk endorsement, entry on minutes, and thirty-day transmittal to trial court
headings.reviewNote: Directs appellate clerk to endorse filing date, enter on minutes, and transmit copy to trial court within thirty days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and Mo. Const. Art. V § 12 cross-reference; refined subsection 1 title to reflect authoring, concurring, and dissenting votes.

headings.title: Transfer to proper court of appeals district from wrong court
headings.reviewNote: Requires wrong court of appeals district or supreme court receiving an appeal or writ of error to direct clerk to forward transcript and transfer order to proper appellate district.

headings.title: Transfer of cases sent improperly to court of appeals instead of supreme court
headings.reviewNote: Directs court of appeals to transfer improperly filed cases to supreme court immediately, proceeding as if directly appealed.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and Mo. Const. Art. V §§ 10-11 cross-references; refined subsection 1 title to reflect transfers from either wrong appellate district or supreme court.

headings.title: Designation of official stations for appellate and supreme court judges
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes official stations at court seat, county courthouse of customary residence, or other county office.

headings.title: Presiding circuit judge authority to provide office space
headings.reviewNote: Permits ("may provide") presiding circuit judge to provide suitable office space, if available, upon request by an appellate or supreme court judge for judge and staff.

headings.title: Written notification of official station to state courts administrator
headings.reviewNote: Requires appellate judges to notify state courts administrator in writing of official stations outside court seat city.

headings.title: Travel and mileage allowances between official stations and court seats
headings.reviewNote: Entitles appellate judges and staff to state official travel and mileage allowances between stations and court seats.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections; revised subsection 2 title to preserve permissive "may provide" office space despite mandatory-sounding catchline.

headings.title: Annual salaries, temporary assignment expenses, and chief justice compensation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes annual salaries, temporary assignment expense reimbursements, and additional chief justice compensation.

headings.title: State treasury payment as total compensation for judicial duties
headings.reviewNote: Mandates payment from state treasury as total compensation, barring additional payments for judicial duties.

headings.title: Practice of law ban and twenty-four-month supreme court appearance bar
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits judges from practicing law or holding compensated public employment during office, and bars supreme court practice for 24 months after resignation or retirement.

headings.title: Certification and payment of temporary assignment expenses
headings.reviewNote: Directs payment of section expenses from state treasury upon certification by transferred or assigned judges.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections and Appendix D salary index note; refined subsections 3-4 titles to cover both resignation/retirement and all temporary assignment expenses.

headings.title: Supreme Court Publications Revolving Fund creation and revenue sources
headings.reviewNote: Creates revolving fund administered by supreme court clerk for publication sales, pending issue digests, and opinion summaries.

headings.title: Reasonable subscription charges and public officer fee waivers
headings.reviewNote: Directs clerk to establish reasonable subscription charges covering compiling and mailing costs, permitting public officer waivers.

headings.title: Annual appropriation and fifty thousand dollar exemption from fund reversion
headings.reviewNote: Exempts unexpended fund balances up to fifty thousand dollars from section 33.080 general revenue transfers.

headings.title: Permissive general revenue advance transfers and repayment
headings.reviewNote: Permits general assembly to transfer up to fifteen thousand dollars from general revenue to continue publications, requiring clerk repayment warrant within twenty-four months.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections; revised subsection 4 title to reflect permissive general revenue advance transfers and mandatory 24-month repayment.

headings.title: Judicial Finance Commission creation and member composition
headings.reviewNote: Creates seven-member Judicial Finance Commission appointed by supreme court, including county governing body members from third-class, first-class, and any-class counties.

headings.title: Three-year staggered terms for commission members
headings.reviewNote: Establishes three-year terms for commission members, with initial appointments staggered across one, two, and three years.

headings.title: Appointment of replacements to unexpired commission terms
headings.reviewNote: Directs supreme court to fill vacancies for unexpired terms and permits reappointment to successive terms.

headings.title: Commission procedural rulemaking subject to supreme court approval
headings.reviewNote: Directs commission to promulgate procedural rules effective upon supreme court approval, and permits supreme court to adopt additional governing rules.

headings.title: Budget review duties, written opinions, and annual financial reporting
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission to review petitioned circuit budgets, issue reasonableness opinions, maintain cost records, and report annually.

headings.title: Commission investigative powers, hearings, subpoenas, and survey authority
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to conduct hearings, subpoena records, survey county judicial expenses, and retain consultants.

headings.title: Supreme court de novo petition for review of commission budget opinions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit courts or counties to petition supreme court for de novo review within thirty days of commission opinion.

headings.title: Meetings, quorum, temporary replacements, and conflict disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Governs meeting calls, four-member quorum, permissive temporary replacements by supreme court, and member disqualification for home-county or home-circuit proceedings.

headings.title: Reimbursement of commission member actual and necessary expenses
headings.reviewNote: Provides that commission members serve without compensation but receive reimbursement for actual and necessary expenses.

headings.title: Clerk staff support and employment of court reporters for budget hearings
headings.reviewNote: Directs supreme court clerk to provide commission staff and authorizes employment of court reporters for budget hearings.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 10 subsections; refined subsection 1 title to reflect 7-member composition and subsection 8 title to include meetings and quorum.

headings.title: Basic Civil Legal Services Fund establishment and low-income guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Basic Civil Legal Services Fund from court surcharges and gifts to fund legal services under federal income guidelines.

headings.title: Annual fund allocation formula and prohibition on state lawsuits
headings.reviewNote: Allocates funds at least annually by FLSC formula, bars general revenue transfer and Mo. Const. Art. X § 18 refund use, and bars suing the state with state funds.

headings.title: Priority civil service categories and Legal Services Corporation compliance
headings.reviewNote: Prioritizes family law, domestic violence, elderly, and Social Security cases, requiring Legal Services Corporation compliance.

headings.title: Supreme court fund administration and fee collection expenses
headings.reviewNote: Directs supreme court administration of fund and authorizes using moneys to pay collection and administrative costs.

headings.title: Five-year record retention requirement and state audit authority
headings.reviewNote: Requires recipients to retain financial records for five years or until audited, whichever is sooner, subject to Missouri supreme court or state auditor audit.

headings.title: Annual legislative report on legal services collections and disbursements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual report by January thirty-first to general assembly on moneys collected and disbursed by judicial circuit.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 6 subsections governing Basic Civil Legal Services Fund creation, annual FLSC-formula allocation, non-reversion, state-lawsuit bar, records, and annual report.

headings.title: Child and Family Legal Representation Coordinating Commission composition
headings.reviewNote: Creates nine-member commission within judicial branch, including experienced child counsel, former foster youth, and advocates.

headings.title: Four-year staggered terms and vacancy filling by chief justice
headings.reviewNote: Establishes four-year staggered terms for commission members and authorizes chief justice to fill vacancies.

headings.title: Expense reimbursement for coordinating commission members
headings.reviewNote: Provides that commission members serve without compensation but receive reimbursement for actual and reasonable expenses.

headings.title: Supreme court procedural rulemaking for coordinating commission
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes Missouri supreme court to adopt rules governing coordinating commission procedures and operations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections establishing the 9-member Child and Family Legal Representation Coordinating Commission, staggered terms, expenses, and supreme court rules.

headings.title: Child and Family Legal Representation Fund creation and revenue sources
headings.reviewNote: Creates dedicated legal representation fund in state treasury for legislative appropriations, gifts, and grants.

headings.title: Investment of fund moneys and credit of earnings by state treasurer
headings.reviewNote: Directs state treasurer to invest fund moneys as surplus state funds with earnings credited back to fund.

headings.title: Commission disbursement of fund moneys to judicial circuits for counsel fees
headings.reviewNote: Directs coordinating commission to administer and disburse fund moneys to judicial circuits for uniform child/family legal representation and court-approved GAL/counsel fees.

headings.title: Non-reversion of fund moneys to general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Exempts unexpended fund balances at end of biennium from reverting to general revenue under section 33.080.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all 4 subsections establishing, investing, disbursing, and exempting the Child and Family Legal Representation Fund; aligned subsection 3 note to mandatory "shall".

headings.title: Pilot project appointment of counsel in lieu of guardian ad litem
headings.reviewNote: Permits judge in supreme court pilot circuit to appoint child's counsel instead of GAL for children age 14 or older, barring shared counsel with parent or guardian.

headings.title: Expiration date of pilot representation project on January 1, 2028
headings.reviewNote: Sets statutory expiration date of January 1, 2028, for pilot representation project provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and statutory expiration note (Expires 1-01-28) for pilot-circuit child's counsel appointments in lieu of guardian ad litem.
